figures.alt: Contractor qualification binder beside blank insurance documentation and a project notebook
figures.caption: Trade-partner qualification depends on real records: scope capacity, insurance, financial documentation, safety history, references, and the ability to perform the awarded work.

figures.alt: Commercial planning table with abstract drawings, estimating tools, blank clipboard, and coordination materials
figures.caption: Clear scopes and early coordination reduce the conditions that can become a default problem. The project team needs a common understanding of responsibility before work begins.

figures.alt: Commercial space under selective demolition with retained ceiling grid, opened partition bays, and controlled work areas
figures.caption: When a trade package changes mid-project, the recovery plan has to document existing conditions, remaining scope, sequencing, and the work needed to protect the overall schedule.
